newsitem.title: USA: DepoTech starts trial of DepoMorphine.
newsitem.headline: DepoTech starts trial of DepoMorphine.

text.p: DepoTech Corp on Tuesday said it had begun a Phase I clinical trial of DepoMorphine, a sustained-release encapsulated morphine sulfate that is being developed to treat acute post-surgical pain.
Based on DepoFoam technology, DepoMorphine is targeted at a broad range of surgical procedures from orthopedic and deep abdominal surgeries to Caesarean sections.

The Phase I clinical trial is a dose-escalation study that will assess the safety and pharmacokinetics of single doses of DepoMorphine administered epidurally to volunteers. Up to 30 people will be enrolled, the company said in a statement.
